instruction: Lift the basket more than 8 cm, identify the target object on the conveyor according to the image on the board, pick it up, and place it into the basket.

frames.label: Goal: use the picture on the board to identify the matching conveyor object, put it inside the basket, and raise the loaded basket more than 8 cm as instructed. Match the pictured shape and colors rather than taking the nearest passing object. Loading counts when the matching object stays inside after the picking fingers open; balancing on the rim or remaining in the hand is not enough. The basket and its contents must then rise clear of the belt together. Progress: The board shows a blue glue stick with a large white cap. The light-blue basket is approaching on the belt and is still empty; neither the basket nor the pictured object has been picked up. Next: Angle the right fingers toward the approaching basket end wall and prepare the left hand for the later pickup. Why: Taking the end wall leaves the basket mouth available for loading. Identify the blue-and-white cylinder from the board before reaching for a passing item, since the other objects on the belt are distractors.
